value: Ley 1835 de 2017 (9 June 2017, 'Ley Pepe Sánchez') adds Parágrafo 1° to art. 98 of Ley 23 de 1982: despite the presumed transfer of rights to the producer, the authors of a cinematographic work (art. 95: directors and screenwriters among them) keep in every case a right to equitable remuneration for acts of public communication, including making available and commercial rental, paid directly by whoever makes the communication; it isn't covered by earlier transfers, and authors may not prohibit, alter or suspend the producer's normal exploitation. Educational use without entry charge and entertainment of a business's own workers are excluded (Parágrafo 2°). In force on promulgation.
notes: The WIPO PDF link is signed and expires; the record page (details/18418) issues a fresh one. The scan's own text layer is poor OCR: quote from the image.

It repealed Décret exécutif 21-204 of 20 May 2021 on artists' labour relations (art. 33). No actors' union, guild agreement or minimum fee found.
